GKE Recommender API

## Overview

The following types provide methods to make RPCs. They are a good starting point
to learn about this library.

- `GkeInferenceQuickstartClient`: GKE Inference Quickstart (GIQ) service provides profiles with performance metrics for popular models and model servers across multiple accelerators.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `GkeInferenceQuickstartClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudGKERecommenderV1

func sample() async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudGKERecommenderV1.GkeInferenceQuickstartClient()
  let response = try await client.fetchModels(
    request: FetchModelsRequest()
  /* set fields using .with { $0... } */
)
  print("Success: \(response)")
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-gkerecommender-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-gkerecommender-v1.git --from 0.5.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudGKERecommenderV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudGKERecommenderV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-gkerecommender-v1
```
